messages:
alex (docs): heads up — i'm opening a small PR to document the recent response header rename and add tiny migration snippets (curl + py). will include FAQ.
peter (eng-api): thanks. note: header is now `X-RW-Quota-Remaining`. old `X-Quota-Remaining` will be sent for 30 days. include fallback.
alex (docs): will show both with a case-insensitive lookup example. also plan a short code test example.
nina (product): can you add where to find per-route quota in the console (direct anchor)? PMs keep getting asked.
alex (docs): will add an anchor to /console/usage and a small screenshot from staging preview.
support-bot: A PR has been opened by alex: PR #1217 "quota header rename + migration snippets"
peter (eng-api): also mention `Retry-After` semantics for 429s (seconds or HTTP-date). we updated clients to accept both.
alex (docs): added a tiny helper to parse `Retry-After` and a one-liner explaining dedicated vs on-demand rates.
nina (product): add a short FAQ entry: "why my app sees higher usage than dashboard" (answer: ingestion delays and rounding).
alex (docs): added FAQ and pushed screenshot commit. planning to merge after quick review. ETA tomorrow EOD.
support-bot: PR #1217 merged by alex  commit c4d2e5a "docs: quota header rename guide + snippets"
alex (docs): merged and will notify #support with a short note. closing thread.
